mapper.select: SELECT ATTENDANCE_SEQ AS attendanceSeq, MEMBER_SEQ AS memberSeq, ATTEND_DATE AS attendDate, CONTINUOUS_DAYS AS continuousDays, REWARD_YN AS rewardYn, REWARD_MILEAGE AS rewardMileage, REWARD_TICKET AS rewardTicket FROM ATTENDANCE WHERE MEMBER_SEQ = #{memberSeq} AND TRUNC(ATTEND_DATE) BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} ORDER BY ATTEND_DATE ASC

SELECT ATTENDANCE_SEQ AS attendanceSeq, MEMBER_SEQ AS memberSeq, ATTEND_DATE AS attendDate, CONTINUOUS_DAYS AS continuousDays, REWARD_YN AS rewardYn, REWARD_MILEAGE AS rewardMileage, REWARD_TICKET AS rewardTicket FROM ATTENDANCE WHERE MEMBER_SEQ = #{memberSeq} AND TRUNC(ATTEND_DATE) = #{targetDate}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ATTENDANCE ( ATTENDANCE_SEQ, MEMBER_SEQ, ATTEND_DATE, CONTINUOUS_DAYS, REWARD_YN, REWARD_MILEAGE, REWARD_TICKET ) VALUES ( SEQ_ATTENDANCE.NEXTVAL, #{memberSeq}, #{attendDate}, #{continuousDays}, #{rewardYn}, #{rewardMileage}, #{rewardTicket} )
mapper.select: SELECT NVL(( SELECT BALANCE_AFTER FROM ( SELECT BALANCE_AFTER FROM MILEAGE_LEDGER WHERE MEMBER_SEQ = #{memberSeq} ORDER BY MILEAGE_LEDGER_SEQ DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM = 1 ), 0) FROM DUAL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO MILEAGE_LEDGER ( MILEAGE_LEDGER_SEQ, MEMBER_SEQ, PAYMENT_SEQ, SOURCE_TYPE, CHANGE_AMOUNT, BALANCE_AFTER, DESCRIPTION, CREATED_AT ) VALUES ( SEQ_MILEAGE_LEDGER.NEXTVAL, #{memberSeq}, NULL, #{sourceType}, #{changeAmount}, #{balanceAfter}, #{description}, SYSDATE )
mapper.select: SELECT NVL(( SELECT BALANCE_AFTER FROM ( SELECT BALANCE_AFTER FROM TICKET_LEDGER WHERE MEMBER_SEQ = #{memberSeq} ORDER BY TICKET_LEDGER_SEQ DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM = 1 ), 0) FROM DUAL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TICKET_LEDGER ( TICKET_LEDGER_SEQ, MEMBER_SEQ, PAYMENT_SEQ, SOURCE_TYPE, CHANGE_AMOUNT, BALANCE_AFTER, DESCRIPTION, CREATED_AT ) VALUES ( SEQ_TICKET_LEDGER.NEXTVAL, #{memberSeq}, NULL, #{sourceType}, #{changeAmount}, #{balanceAfter}, #{description}, SYSDATE )
